anti_circularity_note: World-first on layer O: this manifest is the frozen answer key. The engine never receives it; this generator imports only node: builtins and reads nothing under src/. Noise rates and tables come verbatim from the noisy-estate spec (Section 4) where they apply; thread/event/fact counts are scaled to the 60-person world. Layer R carries no overlay and no noise: its truth is the corpus speaker labels. Deviations are recorded in the run record, never smoothed.
honesty_note: Layered design: layer R truth is intra-corpus (AMI/ICSI corpus speaker labels, and the audio slice whose speaker identity is never relabeled); layer O truth is by construction (overlay world model projected onto real document content). Cross-estate identity truth does not exist in the wild data and is never implied. The audio link of substituted transcripts does not survive the overlay, and this is recorded rather than hidden.

qmsum.name: QMSum
qmsum.license: MIT (repackaging); the underlying AMI and ICSI meeting corpora are CC BY 4.0
qmsum.note: Speaker fields in QMSum are canonicalized role handles (AMI meetings: Project Manager / Industrial Designer / User Interface / Marketing; ICSI meetings: Grad A-F / PhD A-F / Postdoc E), not personal names. Layer R ground truth is keyed to these corpus speaker labels exactly as distributed. This deviates from the hunt note (which expected inherited personal names) and the deviation is recorded, not smoothed.

amiAudio.name: AMI Meeting Corpus audio
amiAudio.note: Real speech of real participants. Audio identity is never relabeled and carries no overlay. The committed slice is the per-meeting headset mix WAV. Ground truth is the corpus-provided participant annotation: per channel the AMI global participant id and role, recorded below from the AMI manual annotations (participants are pseudonymous corpus ids). This item runs no scorer on audio; the fixtures exist for later arms.

enron.name: Enron email
enron.license: No license stated on the CMU page; publicly released via the FERC investigation; the page asks users to be sensitive to the privacy of the people involved
enron.note: Founder ruling (binding): benchmark with the archive on this machine only; zero Enron bytes are committed to the repository, raw or derived. The Enron-derived document set is written outside the repository and every committed artifact records aggregates only.

audioNote: The audio slice is committed as data under fixtures/open-estate/audio, kept under the agreed size cap. Audio carries no overlay and is scored by no pipeline in this item. The estate SHA-256 recipe covers text fixtures only; audio files are pinned by per-file sha256 in externalSources.amiAudio.
estateSha256Recipe: sha256 over the text fixture paths in sorted (POSIX separator) order; per file update(path + NUL), update(file bytes), update(one NUL byte). Audio files are excluded from this digest and pinned separately.

layerR.note: Real identity layer. Truth = corpus speaker labels. QMSum renders AMI and ICSI speakers as role handles, not personal names; the ground truth is keyed to those labels as distributed (deviation recorded). Mention surfaces are the corpus labels verbatim.

layerO.note: Overlay identity layer over real document content. Truth by construction.
